stories.headline: Two passenger trains derail in India on the same day
stories.summary: The Kolkata-Sairang Express ran into a dead-end track near Guwahati, Assam, after a reported brake failure, derailing its locomotive and five coaches and leaving eight passengers with minor injuries; hours later four coaches of the Chauri Chaura Express came off the track leaving Kanpur Central, with no injuries.

stories.headline: Douglas County unveils plans for a $100 million regional sports complex in Sterling Ranch
stories.summary: County officials showed plans for the Zebulon Regional Sports Complex, a ballfield-and-tournament hub run with KT Development that's meant to pay for itself and is slated to open by Jan. 1, 2029; some neighbors worry about the timeline and wildlife.

breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 11 close (mimics MMFI). Up from 69.1% and now just over the 70 line.

fear_greed.commentary: Fear & Greed held at 37 (fear) despite the rally, little changed from Tuesday but far above 20 a week ago and below 45 a month ago, so sentiment is recovering from extreme fear without turning confident.

markets.summary: An AI rebound lifted Wall Street on Veterans Day: the S&P 500 rose 1.31% to 7,619.38, the Dow 0.49% to 52,486.49 and the Nasdaq 1.60% to 25,466.19, with CoreWeave's upbeat outlook igniting AI-infrastructure stocks and the S&P now within about 2.6% of last month's record. Small caps joined in, with the Russell 2000 up 0.88% to 2,846.26 and still above its 40-week average. The bond market was closed, so the 10-year yield sat near 5% after Tuesday's hot CPI. Gold futures slipped 0.74% to $4,000.50 and silver futures gained 1.53% to $51.88, both well below their 40-week averages. Nvidia rose 2.87% to $173.73 in the regular session, but after the bell it dropped roughly 8% to 9% on reports its board is weighing the future of CEO Jensen Huang, a risk for Thursday's open.

stories.headline: Nvidia stock drops as board reportedly preps to oust CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary: The WSJ reported Nvidia's board is meeting over Huang's future after the NYT reported a second affair, with an executive who reported to him; shares fell about 8% after hours.

stories.headline: Nvidia stock rises as CEO Huang faces scrutiny over affair
stories.summary: Shares rebounded 2.87% after two down days, with Morgan Stanley dropping Nvidia as a top pick; quarterly earnings are due Nov. 17.

stories.headline: Nvidia downgraded by Baird on CEO, AI capex risks
stories.summary: Baird cut Nvidia to neutral and its target to $200 from $500, citing possible new China export limits and slowing AI capex.

stories.headline: SpaceX shares slip ahead of Starship test flight
stories.summary: SPCX closed at $139.75, down 2.33%, as early gains on FCC acceptance of its 800 MHz spectrum deal faded ahead of Friday's Starship Flight 15; insider lockup expires Dec. 8.

stories.headline: SpaceX to study options to bridge commercial and military satellite networks
stories.summary: The Space Development Agency awarded SpaceX nearly $10 million to study integrating its laser communications with missile-warning and tracking systems.

stories.headline: Cameco renews US$1 billion at-the-market share program
stories.summary: Cameco renewed its ATM equity program through December 2029 and filed a US$3 billion shelf; shares are down about 14% over the past month.

headlines.headline: AI stocks rebound, and Wall Street nearly returns to where it was before last week's sell-off
headlines.summary: The S&P 500 gained 1.3% to within 2.6% of its record as tech led, while rising yields kept pressure on real estate shares.

headlines.headline: CoreWeave sparks AI cloud stock rally, lifts Nvidia as results ease bubble fears
headlines.summary: CoreWeave raised its revenue forecast and said it won't tap unsecured debt markets, lifting Nebius, Iren and other AI cloud names.

weather.summary: A strengthening coastal storm brings a soaking rain, gusty winds and minor coastal flooding to the Northeast Thursday into Friday, with accumulating snow in the higher terrain of New York and northern New England. Much colder air spreads from the Plains to the East Coast behind a strong cold front, with heavy lake-effect snow in Michigan's Upper Peninsula and a widespread frost and freeze across the South this weekend, while a Pacific storm brings heavy rain, strong winds and blizzard conditions in the Sierra Nevada on Friday.
